title: Termwise representatives give derived coproducts
statement: For every scheme X and family of complexes K_i with chosen isomorphisms Q(K_i) ≅ E_i, the cofan with vertex Q(∐ K_i) and legs E_i → Q(∐ K_i) given by e_i inverse followed by Q of the coprojection is a colimit in D(O_X).

proof.text: Use SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian on the shared carrier of module sheaves, and Abelian.hasKInjectiveResolutions_of_isGrothendieckAbelian to resolve a representative of an arbitrary derived target. Use a proof-only import all Sheaf.CategoryTheory.DerivedModuleDirectSums and use its existing generic lemmas CategoryTheory.derived_map_surjective, CategoryTheory.derived_map_homotopy, and CategoryTheory.coproduct_homotopy: Q is surjective on maps into a K-injective complex, and equality of its images implies homotopy, by CochainComplex.IsKInjective.Qh_map_bijective and the homotopy quotient. Assemble maps with Sigma.desc. Assemble their homotopies degreewise using preservation of coproducts by complex evaluation; this proves uniqueness. Finally compose a requested family of legs with e(i).hom, and cancel e(i).inv and e(i).hom to obtain the displayed cofan universal property. The private helpers are accessed through import all, with their original module, types and proofs unchanged; the source-transport step is proved here in Lean; the same constructions apply to the empty and singleton indexing types.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedAmbientDirectSumsCofan (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : Type u) (E : I → schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (K : I → CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (e : ∀ i : I, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (K i) ≅ E i) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (∐ K))
      (fun i ↦ (e i).inv ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (Sigma.ι K i))))
